name: Returning Pull
description: Pull a foe's own force back toward its source and hold it there.

name: Silver Return
description: Return a blow in a flash of silver light to the place it began.

name: Waking Hour
description: Wake the full dormant strength in a company of allies for one long hour.

name: Hidden Rise
description: Draw every concealed thing in a wide reach up to the surface of the user's sight.

name: Turning Back
description: Turn a grave taint back through its cycle until the ally is clean again.

name: Lunar Orbit
description: Set a champion circling in a pull that grows with every turn it takes.

name: Tide Flash
description: Flash across the field on a tide that carries the user to its far edge.

name: Phase Absorption
description: Draw a blow into the dark phase of the moon and let it fade there.

name: Whole Return
description: The school's own return of the full tide on the field with a weight set by the user's reserve.

name: Lunar Reckoning
description: The school's own reckoning that calls back every force a foe has loosed and drives it home.

name: Tide Cataclysm
description: Raise a tide of the moon's whole pull and drown a region to the destructive ceiling of a Core-tier master.

name: Undone Change
description: Turn a finished change back to the state before it began; no cultivation mechanic explains how a completed change is undone.
